Data.String: Stages 1 (7 L flask) and 2 (72 L lab fermenter) are grown in the microbiology laboratory off-plot; stage 2 inoculates R-211A through a steamed sterile coupling (D-013). Trains B (P-205) and C (P-208) are typicals of train A.

Not aerated (D-019): sterile N2 overlay through PCV-21x6A (restricted trim; 2.0 barg for stages 3, 4; 4.0 barg for stage 5), F-242A/244A/246A and PV-21x4A on PIC-21x4A; vents through F-241A/243A/245A (housing drains to traps). Rupture discs PSE-21x5A (D-036).

Steam blocks: two ball valves, steam fed and condensate bled between them, on every medium, base, inoculum and transfer connection (sterile boundary, D-020). CIP inlets: double-seat valves XV-21x9A with a steamed leakage chamber; sampling: steam-sterilisable aseptic sampling valves (D-036).

Fill batch stop: WIS-21x3A/LIS-2133A high-high closes XV-21x8A (C&E I-211 to I-213). Base: NaOH 10 wt% through the sterile filter F-215 to stages 3 and 4, milk of lime to stage 5 (D-013). Jackets on cooling water.
